svg.title: How CoAIch works: the loop
svg.desc: On your computer, Claude Code runs CoAIch. You start once: setup, a safety check and a program you approve. Then a weekly loop runs: import your workouts and Apple Health data, the weekly review grades last week and proposes next week with reasons, you approve, and it applies. Every four weeks a monthly check-in reviews trends and plans the next month, then the weekly loop continues. Outside services: Strong, openGym and Apple Health send files in; progress photos (front, side, back) go through Apple Vision on your Mac first; Hevy is two-way (workouts in, routines out only with your yes); GitHub receives feedback you post; Anthropic processes your own Claude session. A companion app for food logging and viewing your plan is coming later. There is no CoAIch server.
